page.overview:
Who is Shahal Comanli?

She was 5'2" tall and quite stout, with copper skin. Shahal had a flirtatious streak; in fact, when she chose to flirt, men quickly forgot that she was short and stout.

Shahal is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

She was born roughly 200 years ago in Arad Doman. Nothing is known about her training, but she is likely to have been raised Aes Sedai sometime between between 835 and .

Shahal Comanli was one of the unaligned sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.
